prompt: Hi — I manage device intake at a repair depot. We just received a new batch of Apple devices and I have a CSV file at data/incoming/device_inventory.csv with their serial numbers. I need a consolidated JSON report called inventory_report.json that identifies each device as completely as possible. For each device, I want to know where and roughly when it was made, what model it is, and whether it needs any further manual lookup to be fully identified. If a serial can't be decoded locally, the entry should tell us exactly where to go for more info.
